Agent Name: Gaming_Awards_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the game that won the British Academy Games Awards in 2019. The task specifically asks for the 2019 winner, which is "The Last of Us Part II" (released in 2020 but won the 2019 awards for Best Game). The agent selected "God of War" (2018), which won the 2018 awards. This fundamental error in identifying the subject of the query led to the entire subsequent analysis (Wikipedia page lookup, release date, and revision count) being based on the wrong game.
